subject: Retention exception: out-of-cycle equity refresh + spot bonus for Ethan Park
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: out-of-cycle equity refresh + spot bonus for Ethan Park — retention exception

Laura —

Following up from our 1:1 this morning. Ethan (Eng II, backend) received a strong external offer last week and has raised retention as a concern. He's a high-impact IC: led the query-sharding project (Q1) that recovered ~18% tail latency and is currently owning the migration of the realtime KV cache. Losing him would materially delay two near-term roadmaps (Realtime Cache and CDN K/V) and increase contractor spend.

Ask: approve an out-of-cycle compensation exception so we can offer a retention package: a spot bonus of $12,000 (one-time, non-recurring) and an equity refresh of 0.12% (time-vested per policy). I recognize this is outside the usual refresh cadence for his level; I've attached the promotion/impact packet and peer feedback for context.

Rationale (brief):
- Market: comp benchmarks show he is ~8 percentile below market for total comp (attached).
- Impact: single-threaded ownership of two product-critical migrations.
- Retention urgency: candidate has a signed term sheet contingent on his counteroffer window (48 hours).

Budget: I recommend charging to ENG-RET-23 (headcount/retention pool). If we need to trim the ask I can reduce equity to 0.10% or convert part of the bonus into RSUs — open to options.

Next steps: 
- Laura: can you confirm whether this needs comp committee review or if VP approval is sufficient?
- Vivek: please advise on level of approval you want to provide and budget routing.

Thanks — appreciate any quick guidance.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Core Platforms
Redwood Inference

Attachments: promotion_packet.pdf; peer_feedback.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: out-of-cycle equity refresh + spot bonus for Ethan Park — retention exception

Karthik —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. This is the type of case we route as an exception (out-of-cycle refresh + spot). Per policy, anything outside standard refresh cadence and >0.10% for ICs requires VP sign-off and comp committee notification. Given the $12k+equity ask, I will need the completed comp_exception_form and a short calibration note comparing Ethan to peers at level (one paragraph).

Can you send those two items and a market comp snapshot? Also confirm whether the bonus is taxable cash or equity-based payout (you mentioned non-recurring — please confirm). If we get the materials today I can escalate to recruitment comp and request an expedited committee window for tomorrow.

I'll flag FIN-3421 for budget alignment and put the DocuSign template on standby.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Requested by: Karthik Iyer (Director)

I've set the preferred budget code to ENG-RET-23 and confirmed that the bonus should be cash (one-time, taxable) per the manager preference.

Please see attached: comp_exception_form.xlsx; market_benchmarks.csv; 1-on-1_notes.pdf

Karthik

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the packet. I approve an exception with the following conditions:
- Equity refresh approved at 0.12% effective immediately (vest schedule per standard refresh) — approving slightly below ask to keep comps calibrated across the team.
- Spot bonus approved at $12,000 (cash) to be paid on the next payroll once paperwork completes.
- Charge to ENG-RET-23, pending FIN confirmation (please file FIN-3421).

Please proceed to comp committee for notification; this does not require a full committee reversal but we should LOE this as an expedited notify-and-file. Laura, please prepare the DocuSign grant and bonus paperwork. Karthik, please let me know if you want a small manager-level uplift to base instead of cash; otherwise cash bonus is fine.

Vivek
